title: ChatGPT Desktop variants have different plugin capability
summary: The Codex/OWL Desktop build accepted the local plugin path; ChatGPT Classic 1.2026.184 did not provide the same installation capability during CT-03.
claims: CT-03 primary acceptance runtime is ChatGPT Powered by Codex & OWL 26.930.31730.
Classic remains a separate compatibility track until verified.
decision: Do not block CT-03 on Classic compatibility.
rationale: Primary acceptance should close on the runtime that exposes local plugin installation.

evidence.note: User installed local plugin in Codex/OWL build but not Classic.
